intro: One of four labour codes in force since 21 November 2025. Replaces 13 laws including the Factories Act and Contract Labour Act — covering safety, health, working hours and conditions.

sections.p: Every employee must be given an appointment letter setting out their role, wages and terms.
Normal work is capped at 8 hours a day and 48 hours a week, with a weekly holiday. Overtime must be paid at twice the normal wage rate and needs the worker's consent.
Women can work in all establishments, including at night (before 6 am and after 7 pm), with their consent and the safety, holiday and working-hour conditions set by the government.
Employers must provide free annual health check-ups for workers aged 40 and above, as prescribed.

Contractors supplying 50 or more workers need a licence. The principal employer must ensure contract workers get facilities like canteens and drinking water, and must pay wages if the contractor fails to.
Migrant workers earning up to a set limit get an annual travel allowance to visit home, and can access ration benefits anywhere.
